reviews.scope: Source-bound acquisition subpath with minimal state; no complete FFI, public polling recovery, model, GPU, installation or hardware qualification.
reviews.review_scope: Actual source acquisition/error block and default discovery; no full model/FFI/public polling recovery, GPU or hardware acceptance
reviews.review_reason: The poisoned error owns the mutex guard. Consuming it records the original internal failure and returns without relocking or clearing poison. Healthy/cancelled states and unrelated requests remain intact. The source-extracted owned-child controls detect the original deadlock and bound termination; missing boundary/compile/child failures cannot be reported as success.
reviews.validation: Windows x64 native Rust 1.99.1: original source two healthy passes and one owned poisoned-child 3s timeout; repaired explicit and normal-discovery cohorts each 3 passes, no skips; independent normal discovery 3 passes. CPU-only pcai-media ffi check and strict Clippy passed with pinned compiler. Fresh seven-file Git export also built --locked/--offline and passed 3 controls.
